pyqgis_plugin.name: UPWISE Chat for QGIS
pyqgis_plugin.description: Chat dock for QGIS backed by a long-lived Claude Code CLI session.
pyqgis_plugin.about: A thin chat dock widget for QGIS. Reasoning and tool execution run in a separate long-lived Claude Code CLI process (stream-json in/out), so the plugin reuses an existing Claude Code installation and its subscription authentication. 0.1.0 includes streaming chat, a tool-use approval bar, skill preset buttons with prerequisite checks, and UPWISE branding. Requires the Claude Code CLI and, for map control, the QGIS MCP plugin with the UPWISE toolkit.
